sections.Profile:
"Valiant" is a two-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Williams Electronic Manufacturing Corporation in August 1962. Designed by Steve Kordek, with artwork by George Molentin, the game features a medieval knights theme, complete with swinging targets and kick-out holes that challenge players to achieve high scores. ​ The playfield includes four flippers, two pop bumpers, three passive bumpers, two slingshots, four kick-out holes, three rollover buttons, and two swinging targets

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1962
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
